summary: Nora no longer writes document links herself: the link to a document she just saved is added to her reply automatically, and a document link she makes up is removed. The room is told the truth by the link itself: if it is not there, nothing was saved.
details: This replaces the first version of the guard, which held back her whole reply and sent a generic apology instead.
To link an older document she has to open it first.
limitations: She can still write that a document was made in her message; only the link is controlled.
A link to some other website is not touched.
